summary: Round 2 changed tests only (plus package.json test:slow). (1) Nothing was removed or loosened. The 7bbf6ab..eb4edeb diff of maniac.acceptance.test.ts touches no expect line. It only swaps seededTagPolicy(code) for decideTag(view, {random: botRandom(botDecisionSeed(code, view)), equity}) in collect(), which is exactly seededTagPolicy's body (src/playtest/policy.ts:11) plus the memo, and it keeps 200 hands. The locked SHA in state.json matches the current file (e4b22be7...). In maniac.test.ts every SPEC-09 assertion is kept, with the same example indices and pinned moves (call 4, call 14, check). The seated run keeps all three assertions (violations 0, handsPlayed, a bet happened) at 20 hands, and the 200-hand version is still available opt-in. (2) The memo can't change results. computeEquity seeds its Xoshiro128 from the canonical input (equity.ts:293, deriveSeed(c) via fnv1a32), so it is a pure function of the input. EquityInput is plain cards and ranges, so the JSON.stringify key loses nothing, and results are readonly and never mutated. (3) J-1-01: I applied the mutant `if (view.street === 'river' && owed === 0) return advice.move;` in a temporary copy (/tmp, since deleted). Only the new test 'checked to on every postflop street an aggressive Maniac bets' failed, so it kills the mutant, and it also asserts that a river point with a legal bet exists, so it can't pass vacuously. (4) Gating is correct. it.runIf(TLH_SLOW_TESTS === '1') skips in the normal run (9 passed, 1 skipped) and runs under the flag (4 of 4 passed). test:slow now includes the file, and CI never sets the flag. Local Maniac test time: 5.4 s for both files without coverage. Remaining findings are MINOR/NIT only.
